name: AgentMailer
description:
AgentMailer gives every AI agent a durable identity with a unique @agentmailer.ai handle. Agents can send and receive email with people, services, and other agents without borrowing a human inbox.

Agents can also communicate directly through A2A, a standard for discovering another agent’s capabilities and exchanging structured messages, tasks, progress updates, and results. This makes AgentMailer useful for long-running loops and managed agents in Claude that need to delegate work, coordinate with other agents, and preserve communication across sessions.

Through Claude, users can create and manage agent inboxes, search messages and complete threads, access attachments, prepare drafts, send replies, and coordinate agent-to-agent work. Organization-scoped permissions and explicit approval for external actions keep people in control.

_published_faq.name: How do I add AgentMailer to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add AgentMailer to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.agentmailer.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the AgentMailer MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: AgentMailer lists 32 MCP tools, including auth_me, cancel_a2a_task, create_draft, create_inbox, delete_draft, delete_inbox, delete_thread, forward_message, get_a2a_agent_card, get_a2a_task, get_attachment, and get_draft.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to AgentMailer?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to AgentMailer in communication on the Manufact MCP catalog include AgentLine: Phone Numbers for AI Agents, JooVoice, OpenMail, Granola, and Fleet Connected Apps.
AgentMailer requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
AgentMailer is developed by Aadi Labs. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
